_about: Regions for SVS 4285 IMERG near real-time precipitation (30 hourly frames, 14 Nov 00:00 to 15 Nov 05:00 UTC). Owner: Student A. Default threshold 12, no setting change. Checks in source_manifest.json.
shape: Circles, radius 100 px, same for both regions.

regions.name: Long rain band in the South Pacific
regions.description: Open ocean in the South Pacific, where a long band of rain runs through the circle, so its lines mostly share one direction.

regions.name: Scattered showers on the equator in the central Pacific
regions.description: Open ocean on the equator in the central Pacific, where tropical showers pop up in small patches pointing every way.
